title: Repaint
body:
Repaint is the browser redrawing pixels for elements whose appearance changed but whose geometry did not — a new `background-color`, `visibility`, or `box-shadow`. Nothing has to be re-measured, so it's meaningfully cheaper than [[Reflow]].

The ordering worth remembering: a reflow always forces a repaint afterwards, but a repaint does not force a reflow. That's the whole reason performance advice steers you toward properties that only repaint (or that skip both and run on the compositor, like `transform` and `opacity`). Both happen on your machine, in the browser's rendering engine, after a [[DOM]] mutation.
